verdict.rationale: Kick's own docs show two thin pieces of support: the Advanced plan lists "migration support", and the Universal Importer accepts PDF bank statements or CSVs to backfill historical data. That importer brings in bank-level transactions, not books exported from another accounting system, and nothing shows that categorizations, journal entries or other transaction detail survive a migration. Missing for 10: a documented importer for other accounting systems (e.g. QBO/Xero ledger or journal import), documented preservation of categories, chart-of-accounts mapping and opening balances, self-serve migration outside the custom Advanced plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail

citations.quote: Everything in Plus, plus migration support and a dedicated support team.
Upload PDF bank statements or CSVs for institutions not supported by Plaid, or to backfill historical data.
